sql: SELECT customer_type, ROUND(AVG(n), 1) AS documents_per_application FROM (SELECT c.case_id, c.customer_type, COUNT(d.document_id) AS n FROM caseflow.cases c LEFT JOIN caseflow.documents d ON d.case_id = c.case_id WHERE c.received_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.case_id, c.customer_type) AS per_case GROUP BY customer_type
explanation: Counts documents per application, then averages by customer type.
